name: My submission history
description: The caller's own versions, private rows included. The session check cannot be a join inside the aggregate as it is on the other authed reads: json_agg with no GROUP BY returns one row whatever it is fed, so a revoked session would have got 200 and an empty list -- a rejection indistinguishable from having submitted nothing. live_sessions is therefore the outer FROM, which yields no row at all when the session is dead, and `deny` tests the `session_ok` marker rather than `body`, because an empty list is falsy.

input.query: SELECT (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.created_at DESC), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT e.id, e.name, u.handle AS owner, g.slug AS game, e.created_at, e.retired_at IS NOT NULL AS retired, (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object( 'version_id', v.id, 'version', v.version, 'class', v.weight_class, 'size_bytes', v.size_bytes, 'status', v.status, 'phase', model_phase(v), 'reject_reason', v.reject_reason, 'created_at', v.created_at, 'season', (SELECT se.slug FROM seasons se WHERE se.id = v.season_id), 'ratings', model_ratings(v.id, ($4)::float8), 'last_played_at', (SELECT max(mt.played_at) FROM match_seats ms JOIN matches mt ON mt.id = ms.match_id WHERE ms.version_id = v.id)) ORDER BY v.version DESC), '[]'::json) FROM model_versions v WHERE v.model_id = e.id) AS versions FROM models e JOIN users u ON u.id = e.owner_id JOIN games g ON g.id = e.game_id WHERE e.owner_id = ($1)::uuid AND (($2)::text IS NULL OR g.slug = ($2)::text)) x) AS body, ls.sid AS session_ok FROM live_sessions ls WHERE ls.sid = ($3)::uuid AND ls.user_id = ($1)::uuid
